description: Minimal IPC access for content tabs (which can browse to arbitrary external sites) - grants only allow-report-context-menu, allow-report-favicon, allow-report-content-click, allow-report-login-submit, and allow-report-login-form-present, scoped to webviews matching the content-* label prefix create_tab_webview assigns. 'remote' is required since content tabs load non-local pages by design; report_context_menu, report_favicon, report_login_submit, and report_login_form_present must therefore treat their inputs (target_type/href/src/selection_text; favicon href; login host/username/password; and login-form host respectively) as untrusted (a remote page's own JS could call any of them directly, not just context_menu.js/favicon.js/password_capture.js) - validate rather than trust. report_content_click takes no input, so there's nothing there to validate. Guarded again directly in main.rs via require_content(), mirroring chrome.json's require_chrome() pattern.
